name: University of Inland Norway (INN)
summary: University with campuses across inland Norway; its Game School in Hamar teaches two English bachelor's, in game art and animation and game technology.

ib.text: The IB Diploma, with English, meets the entry requirement; Norwegian is not required for either game degree. With a Nordic school background you apply through Samordna opptak.

apply.via: INN's own application, or Samordna opptak (Nordic schooling)

dates.label: Application opens for EU/EEA applicants (page gives no year)

programmes.name: Bachelor in Game Art and Animation
programmes.ib: Entrance exam, plus an interview if needed. In 2026 the exam was due 15 May, or 1 May if you want student housing; 2027 dates not yet published.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Game Technology
programmes.ib: Maths at Norwegian R1 level: any IB maths (AA or AI, SL or HL) at grade 3 or better covers it.

notes: The two game degrees share projects every semester, so artists and programmers build games together.
INN's Philosophy, Politics and Economics bachelor in Lillehammer is taught in Norwegian, not English.
INN sends applicants 'with upper secondary education from the Nordic countries' to Samordna opptak, and an IB from a school in Denmark is upper secondary education in a Nordic country.
